findings.title: sysid adoption gate admits UA errors up to 28.7% at adoptable sensor noise
findings.claim: On the three shipped presets, with the room sensor the only noisy input, 14 of the 75 experiments that clear the production adoption gate (completed and confidence >= 0.3) identify UA more than 10% wrong, worst -28.7% at confidence 0.978, and _adopt_system_identification blends that value into the persisted heat-loss scale at that confidence.
findings.mechanism: The ported intercept ridge (SLAB_INTERCEPT_PRIOR_SD_KW=0.1) is one pseudo-observation on G; the comfort bound holds the experiment's dT within a few percent of its mean, so UA and G are collinear and a ridge on G buys UA no error bar. _slab_confidence is R^2 x rows x excursion x residual SNR and contains no term for the UA standard error, so a clean-looking window reports ~1.0 while its slope is 29% off.

evidence.unit: count of gate-admitted grid cells with |UA bias| > 10 %
evidence.contention_note: fan-out live; load1=12.0; all values are counts of production arithmetic, contention-immune
evidence.tolerance: ±2 cells (seeded grid, seed=cell index; not wall-clock dependent)

findings.metric_definition: count of grid cells whose identify_slab UA (SysIdResult.heat_loss_kw_per_c) passes completed and confidence>=0.3 and is >10% from the plant's true UA (heat_loss_coefficient*house_heat_loss_scale)

null_control.note: 0 of 24 admitted cells biased at zero sensor noise; largest |bias| over all 24 experiments 1.33549e-12 %

reproduction_steps: expect RESULT admitted_and_biased=14 count, RESULT admitted=75 count, RESULT worst_adopted_bias=-28.7018 pct
perturbation arm: add --sigmas 0.02 -> admitted_and_biased=6; null arm: --sigmas 0.0 -> 0
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Add an adoption gate on the fitted UA's own uncertainty (profile-likelihood interval, or the ridge's pull on G against the fit curvature), or price that uncertainty into the blend weight at coordinator.py:10470-10473 instead of using R^2-class confidence. Not a one-line change: the confidence formula has no term for the parameter of interest.

findings.title: 379-line production method has no production caller; ratchet metric cannot see it
findings.claim: SystemIdentification.identify is entered 0 times by the production call sequence on a declared plant (arm sets _slab_pair, so _finish routes to identify_slab), and tests/structure_budgets.json's dead_top_level_symbols=0 covers only module-level definitions while the package holds 1 unreachable statement (optimizer.py:2100).
findings.mechanism: arm(now, plant=...) sets _slab_pair whenever slab_mode_identifiability passes, and make impossible the only precondition identify_slab's own guard names (_slab_pair is None). Both production call sites of identify are inside sysid.py itself. The companion one-state sizer _predict_step_excursion is entered 0 times too, its only caller being a _LOGGER.debug.

evidence.unit: entries into SystemIdentification.identify during one production experiment

perturbation.change: drop the plant= declaration from the arm call (--no-plant), which is the only input sysid._finish routes on

findings.metric_definition: count of runtime entries into sysid:SystemIdentification.identify, by a sentinel wrapping the production method, over one complete production experiment on a shipped preset
reproduction_steps: expect RESULT identify_calls_production_path=0, RESULT identify_slab_calls_production_path=1, RESULT identify_loc=379 lines, RESULT dead_statements_unreachable=1
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Decide whether the one-state regression is the intended cadence-gap fallback (then sysid.py:1438-1471's by-name refusal is the bug and the fallback should call it) or is dead (then delete identify, _predict_step_excursion and the tests pinned on them, and give dead_top_level_symbols a statement-level sibling in tests/structure.py).

findings.title: production two-state fit raises uncaught OverflowError out of the update cycle
findings.claim: On the heavy_old preset with a room sensor drifting at 0.05 degC/h, identify_slab raises OverflowError out of _finish in 4 of 4 seeds, and coordinator._run_system_identification has no try, so the exception unwinds through _async_update_data and fails the whole update cycle.
findings.mechanism: _lm_solve documents 'projection of the linear parameter into its loose band' but clips only candidate[2]; on the third multi-start (mult=3.0) the log-UA iterate walks outward (-1.17 -> -100.4 -> -223.3) and then overflows exp(x[0]) to +inf. _simulate_slab_path feeds inf into ThermalModel.simulate_step, where _stability_substeps computes an infinite ratio and int(np.ceil(inf)) raises. residual() has no finiteness guard and identify_slab does not catch it.

evidence.unit: count of experiments where identify_slab raised

findings.metric_definition: count of complete production experiments on which SystemIdentification.identify_slab raises instead of returning a SysIdResult, over presets x drift x seeds

null_control.note: 0 of 12 raise at zero drift; all 12 complete

reproduction_steps: expect RESULT fit_exceptions=8 count of 48, RESULT exception_kind_OverflowError=8 count
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Bound x[0] and x[1] where x[2] is already bounded in _lm_solve (sysid.py:545), and make residual() return a large finite cost for a non-finite rollout; optionally also make the sysid call in coordinator.py:4921 defensive.
